description: The local museum's security system is hacked and disabled by an unknown perpetrator.
A former museum employee, now a skilled thief, uses the hacked system to gain unauthorized access to the museum after hours.
The thief, disguised as a janitor, enters the museum's storage room where the manuscript is kept.
The thief uses a customized lockpick to open the display case containing the manuscript.
The manuscript is carefully removed from the display case and replaced with a fake replica to avoid immediate detection.
The thief escapes the museum undetected, leaving behind no evidence of the theft.
The archivist, Clara, arrives at the museum the next morning to prepare for the auction and discovers the theft.
Clara realizes that the stolen manuscript contained a valuable, hidden historical document that only she knew about.
The former employee, now in possession of the manuscript, attempts to contact a black market buyer to sell the valuable item.
Clara starts investigating the theft, following a lead that the former employee might be involved, obstructing her goal to recover the manuscript.
Clara interviews other former museum employees to gather more information about the theft
The former employee receives an offer from the black market buyer to meet in person to finalize the sale
The former employee researches the black market buyer's identity and reputation to ensure a safe transaction
Clara discovers a suspicious transaction record related to the former employee's bank account
Clara obtains a search warrant to investigate the former employee's residence
The former employee becomes aware of Clara's investigation and prepares to leave the country
